sections.description: Manage support plans, website permissions and private plugin updates.
sections.changelog:
= 0.4.0 =
* Use the shared MTT admin UI library for consistent controls, layouts and keyboard focus.

* Add a searchable site overview and separate production and staging reports.
* Review update outcomes and limit new releases to selected pilot websites, with promotion and pause controls.

= 0.3.0 =
* Support automatic private release publication from reviewed GitHub releases, with checksum verification and safe retries.

= 0.2.0 =
* Add verified pending website approvals and installed plugin reports.
* Clarify when an update ZIP has not been uploaded.

= 0.1.1 =
* Explain connecting bundled MTT plugins with one shared website key, without a separate connector.

= 0.1.0 =
* Add manual website registration, support plans and individual plugin permissions.
* Add private releases, scoped website keys and authenticated WordPress update delivery.
